info.title: Capital FM Mobile Ecosystem - Node.js Backend Gateway
info.description: Production-ready Backend-for-Frontend (BFF) API Gateway for Capital FM Kenya mobile application.

get.description: Returns HTTP 200 OK with server uptime metrics.
Monitors downstream PostgreSQL and Redis connection health.

200.description: All downstream database and cache services are healthy.

503.description: Degraded state. Database or Redis unreachable.

get.description: Returns available content categories (News, Sports, Business, Lifestyle, Entertainment) with article counts and descriptions.

Returns sanitized news articles with category filtering, pagination, and PostgreSQL Full-Text Search. Each article carries `authors[]` (every author on the story, main author first, then co-authors; use it for the byline) alongside `authorDetails` (main author). Every listed article also carries `isVideo` (true when the story has a YouTube video); the listing is otherwise unchanged. The `video` object to play is on /api/v1/news/{idOrSlug} and /api/v1/videos.

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: Category slug (e.g. news, sports, lifestyle, entertainment)

get.description: Returns one article by WordPress ID or slug, with full content, `authors[]`, `video` (the story's YouTube video from the website: provider, id, url, watch_url, embed_url, thumbnail {default, medium, max}, is_short; `null` when the story has none) and `isVideo` (true exactly when `video` is not null). When the YouTube box is empty but the body embeds a YouTube video (player, WordPress embed block, or a bare video link on its own line; not text links, channels or playlists), `video` is built from the body in the same shape plus `source: "detected"`; the website's video always wins and has no `source`. Listings report `isVideo` for detected videos once the full story has been fetched. Play `video.embed_url` in-app.

get.summary: Authors with at least one published story
get.description: Proxies Capital FM API v2.4.0 `/authors`. Includes co-authors. Each item: id, name, slug, image, story_count, latest_story, url, api_url, articles_url. Served from the gateway PostgreSQL store first and re-synced from the website in the background every 15 minutes, so it survives website downtime.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Alias for per_page (same default and cap of 100); per_page wins when both are sent

200.description: `data` is the author list; `meta` has total, total_pages, page, per_page.

get.description: Proxies `/authors/{id-or-slug}`: list fields plus bio, website and presenter link (or null). Served from the gateway PostgreSQL store first and re-synced from the website in the background every 15 minutes, so it survives website downtime.

404.description: No such author, or the author has no published story.

get.summary: An author's stories, co-written ones included
get.description: Proxies `/authors/{id-or-slug}/articles`, newest first. Articles use the same shape as /api/v1/news, including the `authors[]` byline array and the `isVideo` flag. `data.author` carries the full profile so one call fills an author screen. Served from the gateway PostgreSQL store first and re-synced from the website in the background every 5 minutes, so it survives website downtime.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Alias for per_page (same default and cap of 50); per_page wins when both are sent

200.description: `data.author` profile and `data.articles`; `meta` has total, total_pages, page, per_page.

get.summary: Video stories (one entry per YouTube video)
get.description: Proxies Capital FM `/videos`: stories with a playable YouTube video, newest first. A video used on several stories appears once, under its newest story; the others are in `alsoIn` ([{ id, slug, title, url, api_url }]). Items have the /api/v1/news article shape with `video` and `isVideo: true`. Only the website's videos are listed, never ones the gateway detected in a story body (`source: "detected"`). Cached 5 minutes; when the website is down, served from the stored video stories in the gateway PostgreSQL store (the videos are hosted on YouTube, so they still play). That offline list can differ from the website's: section matches the primary section slug only (no subcategories or numeric IDs), and grouping, alsoIn and total cover only the newest 500 stored video stories.

parameters.name: section
parameters.description: Category slug or ID, subcategories included (news, business, ...)

parameters.name: shorts
parameters.description: true = Shorts only, false = no Shorts; omit for both

parameters.name: per_page
parameters.description: Alias for limit (same default and cap of 50); limit wins when both are sent

get.description: Proxies Capital FM `/videos/{id}`: accepts the YouTube video ID, the story ID or the story slug and returns the story with full content, `video`, `isVideo` and `alsoIn`. Served from the gateway PostgreSQL store first and re-synced from the website in the background every 5 minutes, so it survives website downtime.

parameters.name: idOrSlug
parameters.description: YouTube video ID, story ID or story slug

404.description: No published story with a playable video matches that ID or slug (cfm_video_not_found).

502.description: Website unavailable and no stored copy.

get.description: Proxies `/presenters`. `fields=full` inlines bio, shows and articles. Served from the gateway PostgreSQL store first and re-synced from the website in the background every 15 minutes, so it survives website downtime.

Proxies `/presenters/{id-or-slug}`: profile, bio.html / bio.text, socials, shows[] with their slots, and articles[] when linked to a WordPress author. Served from the gateway PostgreSQL store first and re-synced from the website in the background every 15 minutes, so it survives website downtime.

get.summary: Global Multi-Category News & Podcast Search Gateway
get.description: Performs concurrent full-text search across all news categories (News, Sports, Business, Lifestyle, Entertainment, etc.) and podcast audio episodes. News results (`data.news.articles`) carry `isVideo` like /api/v1/news.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Full-text search query string (can also be passed as 'query' or 'search')

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: Filter by news category slug or 'all'

200.description: Unified global search results containing news articles and podcast episodes.

get.summary: Real-time Concise Live Radio & YouTube Broadcast State
get.description: Proxies Capital FM `/live`: `data.radio` (is_live, stream_url, show, host, ends_at), `data.youtube` (is_live, video_id, channel_id, title, watch_url, embed_url) and `checked_at`. Every youtube key is always present (null when unset). Poll about every 60 seconds; cached 30 seconds to match the upstream. Show the Watch-live button only when `data.youtube.is_live` is true and open `data.youtube.watch_url` (or play `embed_url` in-app). Never gate the button on `video_id`, which can be null while live. The same block is also returned as `data.live` on /api/v1/stream/nowplaying.

200.description: Real-time live broadcast state object containing radio show and YouTube live metadata.

get.summary: Real-time Live Show Progress & Schedule State
get.description: Returns detailed live show state in East Africa Time (EAT), elapsed/remaining time, up_next show, and progress ratio.

get.description: Returns radio show airtime slots, presenter profiles, and real-time live show indicator.

get.summary: Live Now Playing Track, Album Art & Live Broadcast State
get.description: Parses live ICY track metadata, returns 600x600 iTunes album artwork, active show details, and real-time live broadcast state (radio show and YouTube Live metadata).

200.description: Currently playing track metadata payload including embedded live broadcast state.
